It is multi-paradigm numerical computing structure and programming language which allow matrix manipulation, implementation of an algorithm, data plotting, function plotting and to create the different user interface using different programming language including C, C++, Java, Python. The primary focus of inventing MATLAB is to work on numerical computing. <a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/matlab/"><span style="color: #128ce1">Read More</span></a></h6></div></div><div class="technology-text second-technology"><div class="image-technology"> <img class="lazyloaded" data-lazy-src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/Data-billing.jpg" data-was-processed="true" loading="lazy" src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/Data-billing.jpg"/><noscript><img src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/Data-billing.jpg"/></noscript><h5><a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/data-mining-2/">DATA MINING</a></h5></div><div class="text-technology"><h6>Data mining is the process, in which we discover the patterns in large data sets or in a large amount of data. The term Data mining is an interdisciplinary field of computer science with the main goal to extract information from raw data sets using intelligent methods (machine learning, artificial intelligence) and to transfer data into a usable form for further use. <a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/data-mining-2/"><span style="color: #128ce1">Read More</span></a></h6></div></div><div class="technology-text"><div class="image-technology"> <img class="lazyloading" data-lazy-src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/NS2.jpg" data-was-processed="true" loading="lazy" src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/NS2.jpg"/><noscript><img src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/NS2.jpg"/></noscript><h5><a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/ns2/">NS - 2</a></h5></div><div class="text-technology"><h6>NS (network simulator) is the name of a series (discrete event network simulators), which is NS-1, NS-2, NS-3, and NS-4. Network simulators are primarily used in research and teaching. The first type of NS is developed by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL) in 1995-1997. It is the process by which we can analyze the performance of the model when it will be released in the real world. <a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/ns2/"><span style="color: #128ce1">Read More</span></a></h6></div></div><div class="technology-text second-technology"><div class="image-technology"> <img class="lazyloading" data-lazy-src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/clound-computing.jpg" data-was-processed="true" loading="lazy" src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/clound-computing.jpg"/><noscript><img src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/clound-computing.jpg"/></noscript><h5><a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/thesis-in-cloud-computing/">Cloud Computing</a></h5></div><div class="text-technology"><h6>Cloud computing is used to make more storage for computer and to make the computer more powerful using advanced software’s. The term “cloud computing” generally refers to data centers which are available to the user. First utilization of the word "cloud computing" with the present-day setting happened in August 2006. The largest known public cloud (enterprise clouds+ public cloud+ hybrid cloud) is a Microsoft cloud. <a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/thesis-in-cloud-computing/"><span style="color: #128ce1">Read More</span></a></h6></div></div><div class="technology-text"><div class="image-technology"> <img class="lazyloading" data-lazy-src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/wsn.jpg" data-was-processed="true" loading="lazy" src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/wsn.jpg"/><noscript><img src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/wsn.jpg"/></noscript><h5><a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/wireless-sensor-networks/">WSN</a></h5></div><div class="text-technology"><h6>WSN (wireless sensor network) refers to a specially designed sensor for monitoring the physical conditions of the actual environment and stored it in a usable form. WSN has been used in a variety of applications like area monitoring, health care monitoring, air pollution monitoring, and natural disaster prevention. First WSN network used by the United States military in the 1950’s to track and detect the Soviet submarines.<br/><a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/wireless-sensor-networks/"><span style="color: #128ce1">Read More</span></a></h6></div></div><div class="technology-text second-technology"><div class="image-technology"> <img class="lazyloading" data-lazy-src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/vanet.jpg" data-was-processed="true" loading="lazy" src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/vanet.jpg"/><noscript><img src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/vanet.jpg"/></noscript><h5><a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/vanets/">VANET</a></h5></div><div class="text-technology"><h6>VANET (Vehicular ad-hoc networks) are generated by adding the same principle of the mobile ad-hoc network. It is first introduced in 2001 under car-to-car ad hoc mobile communication network. Where the system can be shaped and data can be shared among cars. It was first introduced to provide roadside safety assistant. VANET works under ITS (Intelligent transportation system). <a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/vanets/"><span style="color: #128ce1">Read More</span></a></h6></div></div><div class="technology-text"><div class="image-technology"> <img class="lazyloading" data-lazy-src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/network-security.jpg" data-was-processed="true" loading="lazy" src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/network-security.jpg"/><noscript><img src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/network-security.jpg"/></noscript><h5><a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/thesis-in-network-security/">NETWORK SECURITY</a></h5></div><div class="text-technology"><h6>NETWORK SECURITY refers to observe the unauthorized access, misuse of a computer network or network-accessible resources. It involves the authorization of data only to the network administrator. <a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/thesis-in-network-security/"><span style="color: #128ce1">Read More</span></a></h6></div></div><div class="technology-text second-technology"><div class="image-technology"> <img class="lazyloading" data-lazy-src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/manet.jpg" data-was-processed="true" loading="lazy" src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/manet.jpg"/><noscript><img src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/manet.jpg"/></noscript><h5><a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/thesis-in-mobile-ad-hoc-network/">MANET</a></h5></div><div class="text-technology"><h6>MANET (mobile ad hoc network) is routable or wireless networking environment. It is also known as a wireless ad hoc network. The basic idea behind MANET is to connect the mobile devices wirelessly without a disturbing network. In MANET every device worked as a router and is free to move independently in any direction. In 2009, the US (ARL) and (NRL) developed a mobile ad hoc network. <a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/tools-and-technologies/thesis-in-mobile-ad-hoc-network/"><span style="color: #128ce1">Read More</span></a></h6></div></div><div class="technology-text"><div class="image-technology"> <img class="lazyloading" data-lazy-src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/image-data.jpg" data-was-processed="true" loading="lazy" src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/image-data.jpg"/><noscript><img src="https://cdn.shortpixel.ai/client/q_lossy,ret_img/https://www.techsparks.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/image-data.jpg"/></noscript><h5> <a href="https://www.techsparks.co.in/thesis-topics-in-digital-image-processing/">IMAGE PROCESSING</a></h5></div><div class="text-technology"><h6>IMAGE PROCESSING involves various filtration's on the different level of an image. It is used to enhance the quality of the image or to extract the information using a computer algorithm. It is developed in the 1960's at the JET PROPULSION LABORATORY. By using Digital Image Processing we are able to use a more complex algorithm, which is impossible to do by using analog image processing. <a
